problem_restatement: Determine whether zero prospective oil-shock entries indicates a broken or over-gated route, or an observation window that is still too short.

same_source_historical_warmup.scope: official source-native candleSnapshot warmup; retrospective cadence diagnostic only

archive_development_nominal_completed_tr.scope: different OHLC source and completed-trade rate rather than raw onset rate

archive_development_stress_completed_tra.scope: different OHLC source and completed-trade rate rather than raw onset rate

assessment.reason: Zero entries over 7.33 hours remains plausible under all three rate proxies, and the largest prospective move reached only 42.37% of the frozen threshold. The three rate models disagree materially, so the window is too short to estimate stable cadence.
failure_modes: Poisson arrivals are an approximation and oil shocks cluster by session and event.
The source-native warmup is retrospective and may not represent the prospective regime.
Archive completed-trade rates undercount raw onsets and use a source contract with unresolved candle parity.
No prospective eligible lifecycle exists, so profitability and mechanism-specific execution remain unmeasured.

recommendation: Do not loosen the shock threshold or restore a retired BRENTOIL route. Continue exact source-native observation and expose threshold proximity so the first eligible lifecycle is attributable and reviewable.
highest_value_next_investigation_for_bre: Capture and resolve the first prospective eligible oil-shock lifecycle under the frozen source, entry, target, stop, opposite-signal, and maximum-hold contract.
global_priority_note: The portfolio-wide improvement digest may rank a current v51 route above this external candidate; this record changes only the BRENTOIL evidence diagnosis.
success_metrics: at least one fully resolved prospective lifecycle per configured direction
zero unresolved mark or executable L2 bars across each selected lifecycle
positive stress net and profit factor above one after measured fees and slippage
positive stress net excluding the largest winner before opening validation
falsifiers: A source-native eligible decision is missing from the journal despite a threshold crossing.
Decision delay exceeds the frozen 15-second prospective limit without explicit censorship.
A longer predeclared prospective window shows materially lower or higher cadence than every sensitivity range.
Resolved prospective lifecycles remain stress-negative or largest-winner dependent.
